overview: SalesExpense Pro is a mobile-first expense management app for field sales professionals in Western India. Snap or upload receipt photos, let OCR auto-detect dates and categories, then generate a professional PDF expense report in seconds — ready to share via WhatsApp or Email.
features: Receipt upload from camera or gallery with OCR auto-detection
Smart category suggestion (Cab, Train, Bus, Flight, Hotel, Meal, Other) from receipt text
PDF export: summary page + receipt image pages
Watermark for free tier, clean export for premium
